title: Pet Sitter Handover Kit
method: Live web search + page-level inspection of the listings themselves (external, read-only, $0 spend). Each entry cites the live URL, the displayed price and a verbatim snippet from the page. Pages that rendered no price are recorded as NOT_READ rather than guessed.
scope_note: Pet-sitter handover kits are a small, crowded market with a clear low ceiling: $1.39 to $10, with the deepest 4-edition binder at $10. Our planned $19.00 has no support in this evidence at all.

competitors.name: PET SITTER READY (kindleleaf / Shastri Seepersad)
competitors.notes: 14 reusable cat+dog handover pages, fillable A4 PDF, A4 + US Letter print editions, 6-page quick-start guide, 10 copy-paste messages. Very close to our planned kit shape at $4.
competitors.quote: "PET SITTER READY $4 ... 14 reusable handover pages for cat and dog owners ... A six-page quick-start guide ... 10 copy-and-paste messages"
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: Away Ready Pet and House Sitter Binder (jawwad24)
competitors.notes: The deepest observed single product: pet profile, meds log, vet/insurance/microchip, home access, utilities, plants, mail, daily visit + overnight logs, incident report - across 4 PDF editions. The top of this category's range.
competitors.quote: "Away-Ready Pet & House Sitter Binder $10 ... US Letter Color PDF, US Letter Ink-Friendly PDF, A4 Color PDF, A4 Ink-Friendly PDF, Quick Start / Printing Guide"
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)
